in_hebrew.name: Christi
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Follower of Christ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Christi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘Christos’, meaning ‘Anointed One’. In Christianity, Christ is considered the anointed savior, and the name Christi is given to those who follow Him.

in_latin.name: Christi
in_latin.meaning: Meaning: Belonging to Christ, follower of Christ
in_latin.long_meaning: Long Meaning: Christian name derived from Greek word Christos, meaning anointed one or Messiah. In early Christianity, this name signified devotion to Jesus Christ and adherence to His teachings. The name Christi is a Latinized form of the Greek Christos, emphasizing the Christian's commitment to the teachings of Christ.
